evidence: brain_scout_schedule_* (crates/susi-gemi/src/tests/brain_scout_schedule.rs — 6 tests: leader change and provider death reported drift, identical runs report none, the journal keeps every previous ranking, cadence bounded and overridable, production-wiring scan) and model_catalogue_drift_* (crates/susi-gemi/src/tests/model_catalogue_drift.rs — 4 tests: appeared/retired/re-priced models are drift, a retired model is marked Gone in persisted brain health without deleting history, finish_run snapshots every registered provider). `run_scheduled` production-reached from the daemon maintenance tick (crates/susi-daemon/src/runtime_admin.rs).
notes: All four axes are production-wired. Ranking (T-98): Store::rank orders floor-meeting candidates by cost_per_outcome_usd and the cascade consumes the rank position; unfit never leads. Probing (T-99): scout_probe's fixed 6-prompt set is offline-checkable and feeds verified outcomes into brain evidence through the same registry and arbiter as dispatch. Schedule + drift + evidence (T-107): the daemon's maintenance tick runs a brain_scout subject on the shared ProbeScheduler (default 6h, env-overridable, jittered, budgeted, offline/consent-gated); each run snapshots per-class leaders, diffs against the journal's previous run (LeaderChanged, ProviderDied), and appends one JSON line per run to ~/.susi/brain_scout_runs.jsonl. Candidate freshness (T-128): every run also snapshots the catalogue — registered providers plus the price the ranker would charge them (same catalog_entry_for matching as the cost ranking) — and the diff produces ModelAppeared (already probed by the same sweep, so a new candidate does not wait for a human), ModelRetired (marked FailureKind::Gone in persisted brain health so a re-appearance starts from evidence, and nothing is ever deleted), and ModelPriceChanged. Honest limits: the catalogue is the substrate's candidate set — registry membership plus catalog price; there is no per-model context-limit field in production config (context_length_routing's ModelWindow is test scaffolding), so a context-limit change is not a detectable drift axis until a real limit source exists; and upstream models a provider offers but the user never configured are outside the registry by design — discovery means the registered candidate set keeps itself current, not crawling vendor catalogues.
